headline: Maui Liquor Commission Debates Rule Changes to Help Struggling Restaurants

meeting.body: Maui Liquor Commission Debates Rule Changes to Help Struggling Restaurants
meeting.summary: The Liquor Control Commission met on Wednesday, July 8.
meeting.recap: The Liquor Control Commission met on Wednesday, July 8.[[0:00:31]] Commissioners approved application number 17 from Island Distributing LLC for a wholesale liquor license.[[0:14:51]] They approved application number 18 for a restaurant liquor license.[[0:20:24]] The vice chair said her proposed rule changes aim to make things easier for businesses in a tough economy while keeping public safety in mind.[[0:23:03]] A restaurant operator said he sometimes waits about three weeks for an email reply on his application.[[0:36:26]] The Maui Chamber of Commerce testified in support of clear timelines for processing license applications.[[0:43:28]] The commission voted to have the vice chair work with the department on new wording for the application deadline rule.[[1:05:00]] A second motion asked the vice chair to work with the department on a form to streamline trade name (business name) changes.[[1:51:06]] The commission voted for the same follow-up work on the rules about changing a business's licensed space.[[2:56:14]] The director said a current rule requires separate men's and women's restrooms for customers.[[3:04:29]] Commissioners voted to repeal (remove) that sanitation rule and publish the change in the Maui News for a public hearing.[[3:17:16]] The next available hearing on that change would be in September.[[3:19:06]] The director said 379 of 387 liquor licenses were renewed.[[3:24:27]] A special meeting on the department's full rule rewrite is set for August 4 at 9:00.[[3:43:52]] The next regular meeting is August 12 at 9:00.[[3:43:59]]
decided: The commission approved the meeting agenda.
The commission approved the minutes of its June 10 meeting.
The commission confirmed the department's general licensing actions, items A through I.
The commission approved application number 18 for a restaurant general liquor license.
meeting.next: The application deadline rule will stay on the agenda for next month. A commissioner suggested putting electronic signatures on next month's agenda. The special meeting will cover the department's comprehensive administrative rule changes.
